review_notes: V89 is additive and narrow: it removes only duplicate legacy role rows where the canonical row already exists, then canonicalizes remaining PLATFORM_AUTHOR rows; it does not delete audit history or resource data.
V90 intentionally replaces the previously created platform username index so the active tenantless predicate is actually enforced; it does not delete users or rewrite an applied migration.
The PostgreSQL rehearsal uses an exact dedicated database URL, a unique schema, and schema-scoped cleanup; it refuses arbitrary databases and does not persist credentials.

The local seed is loopback-only, requires a PLATFORM_ADMIN, uses the platform-user API, reconciles only three named fixtures, validates the API password minimum, and keeps passwords out of source and manifest artifacts.
Question deletion now rejects callers without any possible academic-draft mutation capability before resource lookup; Support ticket event fixtures use the canonical platform-manager contract.

Backend, API-client, frontend, Docker migration, live HTTP, and visible-browser evidence are recorded in the Phase 6 test report. Production and non-local release proof remain explicitly out of scope.
